title: TTC Bunching Overview
description: Why buses bunch: reads dbt's gold layer (marts.mart_bunching_events / marts.mart_bunching_hourly) directly -- no custom app, this dashboard IS the end-user view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM marts.mart_bunching_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT route_id) AS value FROM marts.mart_bunching_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT route_short_name AS "Route", route_long_name AS "Name", SUM(bunching_event_count) AS "Bunching events", round(AVG(avg_stop_sequence_gap)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg stop gap" FROM marts.mart_bunching_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(event_hour) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Bunching events per hour (top 8 routes)
panels.description: One line per route, from mart_bunching_hourly -- the event-level mart is too dense to plot directly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.event_hour AS "time", h.route_short_name AS metric, h.bunching_event_count AS value FROM marts.mart_bunching_hourly h JOIN (SELECT route_short_name FROM marts.mart_bunching_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(event_hour) GROUP BY route_short_name ORDER BY SUM(bunching_event_count) DESC LIMIT 8) top ON top.route_short_name = h.route_short_name WHERE $__timeFilter(h.event_hour) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent bunching events -- why they happened
panels.description: Each row: a real detected bunching pair, its route, and the weather closest in time to when it happened (mart_bunching_events, joined via dbt LATERAL). Road-restriction context isn't joined in yet -- see docs/architecture.md Phase 8 for why.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS "Time", route_short_name AS "Route", route_long_name AS "Name", vehicle_id_a AS "Vehicle A", vehicle_id_b AS "Vehicle B", stop_sequence_gap AS "Stop gap", temperature_c AS "Temp (C)", weather_condition AS "Weather" FROM marts.mart_bunching_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
